newsitem.title: UK: Eastern says BT liable for bulk of UK windfall tax.
newsitem.headline: Eastern says BT liable for bulk of UK windfall tax.

text.p: Eastern Group, Britain's biggest electricity distributor, told the Labour government that British Telecom should be made liable for nearly half of the proposed windfall tax on privatised UK companies, said the Independent newspaper.
In a meeting with senior Treasury officials on Monday, the company said the fairest means of levying the tax would be on shareholder gains in the first year after privatisation, said the paper.

Eastern said this would mean British Telecom would be liable for 47 percent of the levy or just under 2.5 billion sterling if the tax raises five billion. Under this proposal, Britain's regional electricity generators would only pay around 13 percent.
Britain's new Labour government has said it plans to introduce a "windfall" tax on the UK's privatised utility companies.
